role_software_developer.impact_summary: Generative AI may change parts of software development, especially work involving written requirements, code-related documentation and testing. The ILO identifies meaningful potential task exposure, while a Malaysian TalentCorp study describes its related Software Engineer role as low AI-impacted; these are different measures, not directly conflicting forecasts.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Testing and validation procedures are included in the ILO occupation tasks. AI-assisted test suggestions may support this activity, but the workbook does not measure real-world adoption.
Software-system design and development are documented occupational tasks. AI tools may assist selected design or coding activities, subject to verification.

role_software_developer.human_responsibilities: Engineers remain responsible for checking whether designs meet requirements, validating outputs, resolving defects and making contextual trade-offs.
role_software_developer.occupation_specific_limitations: The Software Engineer profile used by TalentCorp is not identical to MASCO Software Developers. Exact OECD occupation code is unavailable.
role_software_developer.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

role_accountant_auditor.impact_summary: AI may assist with selected financial-information and reporting tasks. Potential exposure does not remove requirements for audit evidence, financial accuracy, professional judgement or accountability. TalentCorp reports medium impact for selected finance and accounting specialisations only.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: The ILO task list includes preparing and certifying financial statements; AI assistance with drafting or reviewing information is a potential use, not a confirmed replacement.
The ILO lists profit forecasts and budget reporting as occupational tasks that may be affected by information-processing AI.

role_accountant_auditor.human_responsibilities: Qualified professionals must review financial conclusions, assess unusual cases, maintain ethical judgement and meet applicable professional obligations.
role_accountant_auditor.occupation_specific_limitations: ILO ISCO 2411 covers Accountants, while the Malaysian profile combines Accountants and Auditors. The TalentCorp impact label applies only to specified GBS roles.
role_accountant_auditor.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

role_data_professional.impact_summary: Data-oriented work may be affected by AI-assisted statistical analysis and data-management tools. However, the ILO dataset has no direct ISCO-08 category equivalent to Malaysian MASCO 2524, so its example occupations must not be treated as a verified AI-risk rating for all Data Professionals.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Statistical data evaluation and interpretation appear in the ILO representative occupation 2120; they overlap with some MASCO Data Professionals duties.
Database design and data-management responsibilities appear in ILO representative occupation 2521; this overlaps only with part of the Malaysian occupation.

role_data_professional.human_responsibilities: People still need to define useful questions, verify data quality, examine assumptions, explain findings and make domain-specific decisions.
role_data_professional.occupation_specific_limitations: The selected ISCO 2120 and 2521 occupations are partial task comparisons only; no single official ILO gradient or OECD numeric index is available for the full MASCO 2524 occupation.
role_data_professional.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

role_marketing_professional.impact_summary: GenAI may assist parts of advertising content preparation, market research and campaign analysis. Professionals still need to evaluate brand context, customer evidence and strategy. The international exposure indicators do not measure Malaysian marketing job losses.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Writing advertising copy is an ILO-listed task with potential GenAI exposure.
Customer research and analysis are recorded occupational activities, with possible AI support for information processing.

role_marketing_professional.human_responsibilities: Teams remain responsible for assessing campaign suitability, understanding customers, checking claims and making strategic decisions.
role_marketing_professional.occupation_specific_limitations: The O*NET OECD comparison is narrower than all Malaysian advertising and marketing specialisations.
role_marketing_professional.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

role_electrical_engineer.impact_summary: Electrical engineering includes physical systems, safety and design decisions, so the ILO GenAI study places this occupation in its Not Exposed group. That label does not mean other forms of AI, such as predictive-maintenance systems, are irrelevant; TalentCorp describes AI uses in the E&E sector.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Electrical power-system design is a documented engineering task. AI tools might support selected analyses, but this ILO task score alone does not establish actual deployment.
Establishing performance and safety procedures is an occupational responsibility; software support does not replace professional accountability.

role_electrical_engineer.human_responsibilities: Engineers must evaluate physical constraints, standards, system safety and real-world performance before approving designs or changes.
role_electrical_engineer.occupation_specific_limitations: ILO evaluates GenAI task exposure, while OECD considers broader AI capabilities and TalentCorp discusses E&E industry trends. These cannot be merged into one impact grade.
role_electrical_engineer.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

role_nursing_professional.impact_summary: Nursing combines patient-facing care, clinical assessment and communication. The ILO rates the occupation Not Exposed under its 2025 GenAI framework, but this does not rule out AI tools supporting clinical information and administrative tasks. Safe clinical practice requires qualified human oversight.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Health education is an ILO-listed task for Nursing Professionals; AI could support information preparation if checked by qualified staff.
Patient and family communication is an ILO task; AI-generated information would require clinical verification and sensitivity to context.

role_nursing_professional.human_responsibilities: Nurses remain responsible for patient assessment, safe medication administration, compassionate communication, care decisions within their scope and escalating clinical concerns.
role_nursing_professional.occupation_specific_limitations: US Registered Nurses and Malaysian Nursing Professionals have different regulatory and scope-of-practice contexts. Online training is not a substitute for clinical qualification.
role_nursing_professional.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.
